subject.title: fix(cli): one-shot agent --local runs never export OTel diagnostics

question: Should one-shot and gateway-fallback CLI runs accept the bounded exporter-flush delay in exchange for reliable OTel delivery, after the branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: The patch changes short-lived CLI exit behavior at a plugin-service boundary; CI and unit coverage do not decide the acceptable operator-facing latency tradeoff on an updated merge result.

options.title: Refresh and keep the bounded lifecycle
options.body: Rebase, rerun the focused lifecycle checks, and confirm a redacted collector run plus an unreachable-endpoint exit bound on the exact merge result.

options.title: Narrow the shutdown policy
options.body: Keep exporter startup but revise the stop timeout or shutdown behavior if maintainers require faster one-shot CLI exits under collector failure.

options.title: Pause for a different observability design
options.body: Hold the PR if diagnostics delivery for embedded runs should be owned by a different lifecycle boundary than the CLI process.

recommendation.title: Refresh and keep the bounded lifecycle
recommendation.body: Rebase, rerun the focused lifecycle checks, and confirm a redacted collector run plus an unreachable-endpoint exit bound on the exact merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original lifecycle implementation and can provide the most direct technical context while an area owner decides the merge-risk tradeoff.
